fusions.name: Rolling Buzz
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is knocked back 2 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Scale Jab
fusions.desc: A quick jab that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Balled Up
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Rank Closing
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, a shield soaks 30% of your maximum health for 10 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
